admission.justification: A refusal must not falsely imply an earlier published code commit was rolled back or overwrite concurrent content.

applicability: Ordinary closeout refusals after code publication and takeback of owned preparations.
conditions: Takeback applies only while prepared bytes still match; concurrent content is preserved and named.
exclusions: No claim that a code commit made earlier was undone or integrated.
statement: A refusal after the code commit names that commit, says nothing is integrated, and rerunning completes the pair; HistoryClosing.restore reports whether the takeback ran; _restore_preparations returns the skipped preparation paths, and a RuntimeError refusal names concurrent files left untouched rather than claiming a skipped-preparation receipt.
